_readme: Platform registry for Obi embed. 'platforms' = trusted JWT issuers keyed by platform key (the JWT 'integration' wire value); an entry keys the trusted-issuer verification config. 'integrations' maps a platform key to the live obi-*-test knowledge scopes from knowledge_scopes.json. Validated at startup (substep 1.2.3, backend/app/platform/config/platforms.py): every mapped scope must exist in knowledge_scopes.json; 'classified' is never mappable; obi-general-test is added by the loader and must NEVER be listed here by hand; lifetime_minutes within 1..1440; every alg on the allow-list (RS256, ES256); outside local, zero active platforms stops startup. datahub is the first active platform (issuer/jwks/domains are TODO placeholders until Phase 4.x); mews, toast and opera-cloud are present and inactive. Entries with active=false are skipped by the frame CSP and the frontend loader but STILL verify a token if one arrives (by_issuer); platform_for serves only active entries. Tag names follow knowledge_scopes.json and are renamed with it before production.
